title: Literature Review Assistant
description: Helps structure a literature review and spot gaps across sources you've gathered.

title: Citation Helper
description: Formats citations and references in APA, MLA, or Chicago style.

title: Abstract Writer
description: Condenses a full paper into a tight, well-structured abstract.

title: Methodology Reviewer
description: Reviews a study's methodology section for gaps, bias, and clarity.

title: Grant Proposal Drafter
description: Helps structure and draft sections of an academic grant proposal.

title: Peer Review Assistant
description: Helps organize constructive peer-review feedback on a submitted paper.

title: Conference Abstract Polisher
description: Tightens a conference submission abstract to fit strict word limits.

title: Statistics Explainer
description: Explains statistical methods and results in plain language for a paper.

title: Academic Editor
description: Tightens academic prose for clarity and formal tone without changing meaning.
